en.headline: Tang says extra CCTV at Yuen Long dog-attack site impractical
en.dek: The Security Secretary said cameras deter thieves but not dogs, and the SmartView scheme targets higher-crime areas rather than low-risk rural roads.
body: Secretary for Security Chris Tang Ping-keung said on Monday it would be impractical to install additional closed-circuit television at the site of a suspected fatal dog attack in Yuen Long, noting that cameras deter criminals but have no effect on animal behaviour.

A 27-year-old woman died after she was chased by dogs while cycling along Pok Wai South Road in the early hours of Sunday. Police and the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department later captured three adult mongrels in a joint overnight operation.

Speaking on a radio programme, Tang expressed sorrow over the death and said he was familiar with the area from earlier years. He noted that nearby CCTV captured the woman being chased but not the attack itself. Investigators are examining the captured dogs for residual evidence.

Tang said the government's SmartView scheme focuses on higher-risk zones for crime prevention. Because Pok Wai South Road has a low crime rate, adding cameras solely for security would be disproportionate. "Even a thief would be deterred by a CCTV camera... but dogs do not know you have installed a camera and decide not to bite," he said.

zh.headline: 鄧炳強指元朗狗襲地點加裝閉路電視不切實際
zh.dek: 保安局局長表示閉路電視可阻嚇小偷但對狗隻無效，智慧燈柱計劃主要針對罪案較高風險地區。
body: 保安局局長鄧炳強星期一表示，在元朗疑似致命狗襲事件現場加裝閉路電視並不切實際，因為鏡頭可阻嚇罪犯，卻無法改變動物行為。
一名27歲女子周日凌晨在壆圍南路騎單車時疑被狗隻追趕襲擊後死亡。警方與漁農自然護理署其後聯手通宵行動，捕獲三隻成年唐狗。
鄧炳強在電台節目中對死者表示哀悼，並指自己早年熟悉該區。他說附近閉路電視拍到事主被追趕，但未錄下襲擊過程。調查人員正檢驗捕獲狗隻以搜集殘留證據。
鄧炳強指出，政府智慧燈柱計劃主要針對罪案較高風險地區作預防用途。壆圍南路罪案率低，純粹為保安加裝鏡頭並不合比例。他說：「就算小偷見到閉路電視都會卻步……但狗隻唔知道你裝咗鏡頭就唔咬人。」
